Definition: Way, road and journey — a path of life; the earliest name for the Christian faith, and Jesus's own claim about Himself.
BiblicalUsage: Before they were called Christians, believers were followers of 'the Way' (hodos). Jesus declares He is the Way — not one route among many but the road home to the Father Himself.
TheologicalSignificance: Hodos pictures faith as a journey with a sure direction. However winding your road feels, Jesus is both the path and the destination — you cannot lose your way while you stay with Him.
